heading: LEGACY STATEMENT
kickerLines: REVOLUTIONARY LEGAL REFORM IN THE WORLD
paragraphs: Singapore can now be said to be one of the most advanced countries in Asia. The Founder studied Insolvency, Restructuring And Dissolution Act (IRDA) as comparative study. IRDA stipulates: “if a company does not have enough money to pay creditors then debt is reduced proportionally or left open unpaid entirely.” Founder presents constructive criticism to IRDA.

“The substance of bankruptcy is very simple”: only a business legal relationship between Creditors and Debtor in form of money, goods and/or services, then business should grow multiple, mutually beneficial and larger, safe in legal protection, but what happens is opposite, certain business actors as creditors can become poor due to bankruptcy, because Bankruptcy Law is designed by world experts with possibility of cunning passengers infiltrating, making it difficult and complicated.

“With Law, Your Business Is Secured” - therefore Founder holds “revolutionary” view: From all Bankruptcy Law Books and Legal Dictionaries in the world, the words “Unsecured Creditor(s)” should be deleted and replaced by “General Creditor(s)” or “Kreditor Umum”, because the party that fights with a strong legal basis will definitely win. This is consistent with Founder's Theory of Bankruptcy Law in line with Legal Determination which contains philosophy.
DO NOT CHASE POWER - CHASE THE PURPOSE (JOHN D. ROCKEFELLER)

To chase the purpose, Founder contributes thought to Cross-Border Insolvency-Model Law and World Bank as Open Knowledge Repository, led by Mr. Ajay Banga, Indian diaspora, American Nationality. Founder’s view is “correct and accurate” that Bankruptcy Law in parts of world benefits certain creditors but harms other creditors. This argument is a postulate.
legacyParagraphs: Founder statement and aspiration becoming a “Legacy Statement”: By the Grace of Almighty God, at the right time, the Founder or future generation of the Founder will be pioneer in front line accompanying the President of Republic of Indonesia to deliver speech before UN General Assembly conveying “Civilized Law” – “Universalism And Uniformity Of World Bankruptcy Law That Must Protect All Creditors.” There are global business transactions and cross border physically and/or digitally, then it is logical, “One World - One Bankruptcy Law” for civilized countries, for justice and welfare of mankind for generations.
